dataQualityNotes: Combined domestic+international T-100 release trims the last few months of pure-domestic data to keep a uniform end date across sources (SPEC.md §1). Verify full-year 2025 totals are not silently undercounting a recent quarter.

Delay-derived metrics (del15Rate, avgTaxiOutMin, nasDelayPerDeparture, weatherDelayPerDeparture, cancellationRate) are estimated from a single representative month (March 2025), not measured across the full year (SPEC.md §2 "On-Time Performance sampling"). dataCompleteness reflects this: 0.5 for full-year T-100 fields + 0.5 for the sampled On-Time fields, so a fully-present record is 1, not 1.0.
scheduleAdherenceGap can be negative (DEPARTURES_PERFORMED > DEPARTURES_SCHEDULED for some airports) — a known T-100 quirk, not an error; left signed, not clamped (SPEC.md §3).

Row-parse robustness: 2025 T-100 had 0 malformed rows (column-count mismatch) and 0 rows with missing/non-numeric DISTANCE; 2024 T-100 had 0 malformed and 0 bad-DISTANCE rows; On-Time sample had 0 malformed rows. Malformed rows were skipped when unsafe to index into; bad-DISTANCE rows were bucketed as short-haul (distance treated as 0).
